reason: Calcium phosphate crystals should strengthen the arm's collagen framework.
expectation: The mineral will give the bone framework rigidity.

effect: The mineralised framework now combines collagen's toughness with resistance to compression; it still needs living components and a supported joint.
reaction: The contrast between flexible fibres and firmer mineral made their roles clearer.
reason: Bone cells should make the mineralised framework living tissue.
expectation: The bone cells will become part of the arm bones.

effect: The bone cells are embedded in the matrix and connected through tiny passages; the bones still need blood vessels and joint structures.
reaction: The connected cells make the hard bone feel like living tissue.
reason: Blood vessels should supply the living bone cells.
expectation: The vessels will become part of the living arm bones.

effect: The vessels supply nutrients to the embedded bone cells, completing the living arm bones; the elbow still needs its joint structures.
reaction: The picture clarifies how nutrients reach cells inside hard bone.
reason: Articular cartilage should cover the bone ends where they meet at the elbow.
expectation: The cartilage will provide smooth surfaces at the elbow joint.

effect: The elbow surfaces now have smooth cartilage caps, leaving the capsule and ligaments to support the joint.
reaction: The sliding inset makes the cartilage's role clear.
reason: The synovial capsule should enclose the cartilage-covered elbow joint.
expectation: The capsule will surround the joint and provide fluid for smooth movement.

effect: The capsule encloses the joint, and its lining supplies fluid that helps the cartilage surfaces glide. The elbow still needs ligament support.
reaction: The result makes the fluid's role clear.
reason: The remaining elbow ligaments should support the enclosed joint.
expectation: The ligaments will connect and support the bones at the elbow.

effect: The ligaments completed the movable arm skeleton, supporting the elbow while allowing it to bend.
reaction: The distinction between bending and resistance to sideways movement was helpful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding mineral to the collagen framework was most worthwhile because the result clearly distinguished collagen's toughness from mineral's resistance to compression.

leastWorthwhile.text: The later joint-building steps felt somewhat repetitive: each remaining part had an obvious place, so there was little decision-making.

surprise.text: The tiny channels connecting embedded bone cells made bone's living structure more concrete.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt purposeless; each added a component with a plausible role, although the sequence was predictable.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it connected this skeleton to muscle action, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than this mostly straightforward assembly.
